summary: In the main repo, rename a module but keep a deprecated alias by adding an underscore-prefixed symlink, e.g. _fileinfo.py pointing to stat.py.
questions: How do I keep an old module name working after renaming it in ansible-core?

answer_card.title: Rename a module with an alias in ansible-core
answer_card.answer_md:
Create a symlink starting with `_`:
```bash
ln -s stat.py _fileinfo.py
```
Now `ansible -m stat` and `ansible -m fileinfo` both work.
